METHOD v1.0

Method sequence

    Case input coverage0%

    Evidence before certainty. Gates before motion. Every output should be inspectable by someone who did not create it.

    Working case loaded: Artemis web ecosystemAnalysis is grounded in the supplied site inventory and deployment context; unevidenced infrastructure is marked Blocked rather than guessed.

    A subject-agnostic operating method

    Turn ambiguity into an explainable, testable course of action.

    The discipline: separate what is observed from what is assumed, make the reasoning visible, and require proof before declaring a solution.
    01 / TRACEABLE

    Every conclusion can be traced back to evidence, a constraint, or an explicit assumption.

    02 / DIALECTIC

    The method preserves the strongest counterargument instead of hiding disagreement.

    03 / DEMONSTRABLE

    A proposal is not complete until another person can see how and why it works.

    04 / VERSIONED

    Changes become named revisions with reasons, evidence, and consequences.

      Method governance

      Evolve the method without erasing its reasoning.

      A new version earns its number when field evidence changes a prompt, gate, lens, or delivery pattern. Each release records the trigger and impact.

      v1.0 / CURRENT

      Traceable six-phase method

      Initial operating framework for investigation, problem definition, solution reasoning, demonstration, delivery, and learning.

      • Subject-specific audit lenses
      • Evidence-state vocabulary
      • Explicit exit gates
      • Portable strategy brief
      RULE / SEMVER

      How the method versions

      Patch clarifies language. Minor adds a backward-compatible tool or lens. Major changes the phase logic, evidence standard, or governance model.

      Candidate for the next revision

      Complete the Evolve phase to turn a field lesson into a method-change proposal.
